context: An elderly couple recaps a club lunch
purpose: Teach: 思いつき/はなれ/溢れる/心情/各々/持ち込ん/見受け/ノン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昼の集まり、各々の話が溢れる感じで、賑やかだったね。
lines.en: The lunch gathering was lively — everyone had stories spilling out all over the place.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective opening. Warm nostalgia in the voice. Unhurried pace. Slight smile in the delivery, as though savoring the memory of the gathering's energy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ。田中夫人が思いつきで歌を持ち込んでくださって。
lines.en: Yes. Mrs. Tanaka brought a song with her — completely on impulse.
lines.style: Bright recognition. The delight of remembering a particular, small kindness. Soft but present. Lingers slightly on the image of the song arriving unplanned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: その心情、お礼の手紙にしっかり書こう。
lines.en: That kind of heart — let's make sure we put it into a proper thank-you letter.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. A quiet sense of purpose settling in. Slow enough to suggest care. Not hurried — this is the kind of thing worth doing well.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 席をはなれる前に、皆でハグもしたわね。
lines.en: And before we even left the table, we all hugged, didn't we.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender. A touch of wonder at the simple togetherness of it. Soft emphasis on 「all」 — the inclusiveness matters. Trailing off slightly, savoring.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 飲み物はノンアルが中心で、健康的でよかった。
lines.en: The drinks were mostly non-alcoholic — which was nice. Very health-conscious.
lines.style: Approving but not lecturing. A light note of satisfaction. Even-paced, matter-of-fact. The tone of someone noticing thoughtfulness in small choices.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: また来月見受けに行きましょうね。
lines.en: Let's go visit them again next month, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle proposal, warm and inviting. A natural closing thought — looking ahead without urgency. The suggestion of someone who values continuity. Soft, companionable tone.
